title: Move Vapor Wares cask truth into the homebrew-apps division
description: Harvest the newer loose brew/Casks records from the Vapor Wares private arm into the declared homebrew-apps division so the double-gateway layout has one cask authority at gtwy/p/vapor-wares/p/homebrew-apps.
acceptanceCriteria: homebrew-apps carries the current vapor-wares and hello-world-google cask records from the loose brew folder.
homebrew-apps includes the hello-world cask that only existed in the loose brew folder.
The old loose brew folder can be removed from the Vapor Wares private arm after the leaf commit lands.
